observations.formLabels: Localized email and password fields, sign-in action, Google action and create-account action were exposed in the accessibility tree

keyboardSample.scope: Six forward Tab targets observed; no controls activated

limitations: The nine locale/theme states were confirmed through the accessibility tree; contrast and visual appearance were not measured.
Keyboard order is a single forward sequence sample in Spanish/dark; reverse traversal, keyboard traps and other routes were not tested.
No credentials were entered; login, Google OAuth and account creation were not activated.
This does not establish screen-reader output, WCAG conformance, mobile behavior, authentication/RBAC or persisted locale preferences.
No screenshot file was persisted; the tree was observed in the connected browser session.
